name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2025-02-12.235.1) introduced by Victorian Senator [Lidia Thorpe](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/lidia_thorpe) (Independent), which means they failed.
